name: Heels-on-Chair Bridge
description: A bridge with your heels up on a chair seat, which works the hamstrings harder: press your heels down and lift your hips until shoulders, hips and knees line up.

source.title: Feet-Elevated Bridge (Hawkes Physiotherapy)
source.note: From your full-body routine, described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent to 90° and your heels on the chair seat.
cues: Press your heels down into the seat.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes to lift.
Stop when your shoulders, hips and knees make a straight line; lower with control.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Heels on the chair
keyframes.cue: Knees at 90°, heels on the seat.

keyframes.name: Lift your hips
keyframes.cue: Press through your heels and lift.
